_auto: the eval below is an auto-ringer: it presses a lane's key when a GOLD orb crosses the strike line. It must skip .orb.mimic — those are the Cold, and ringing one is a miss.

steps.expect: You are standing on a lid
nothing holds it but the old pattern
A pale blue light is the Cold

steps.eval: (() => { const KEYS=['a','c','m','/']; if (window.__auto) clearInterval(window.__auto); window.__auto = setInterval(() => { document.querySelectorAll('#widget .lane').forEach((lane, i) => { const hy = lane.clientHeight - 58; lane.querySelectorAll('.orb:not(.mimic)').forEach(o => { if (o.__hit) return; const y = parseFloat(o.style.top) + 23; if (Math.abs(y - hy) < 22) { o.__hit = true; window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: KEYS[i], code: 'Key' + KEYS[i].toUpperCase(), bubbles: true })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { key: KEYS[i], bubbles: true })); } }); }); }, 25); return 'auto-ringer on'; })()

steps.expect: You found it in the study
Loved enough to walk back in
Four are burned to a smear
Slot 1 is the first word you read
where is the silence in that
The fire is the hollow they left.
The four bells came through whole
